Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation manifest + MAP: BlueCanyon / Redwood

Hi Priya / Monica,

Thanks again for a great conversation yesterday — we're excited to get started. Attached is our internal MAP export (BC_MAP_v1.1.pdf) and a short list of high-level constraints from our ops team. High level asks:

- 30-day pilot with a canary of ~10% of traffic (non-critical customers)
- Training for 12 product owners and 3 SREs (remote + 1 on-site half day)
- Migration cutover w/ a 2-hour rollback window and DB read-only gating

Can you confirm if Redwood can onboard the dedicated model variant (r-infer-large-q4f) in our US region, and whether we should plan for a seeded cache before cutover?

Attached: BC_MAP_v1.1.pdf (MAP export)

Alex Monroe
Head of Product
BlueCanyon Systems
alex@bluecanyon.co

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@bluecanyon.co>, Jamie Park <jamie.park@bluecanyon.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation manifest + MAP: BlueCanyon / Redwood

Alex — thanks for sending the MAP and constraints. Drafted an activation manifest and embedded MAP recommendations below; attaching our annotated version (BC_MAP_Redwood_comments.pdf). High level plan (proposal):

1) Onboarding & validation (Week 0, 2 business days)
   - Kickoff + access setup (A: Priya)
   - Model variant validation on a mirror dataset (A: Soojin)
   - Pre-seed KV cache with 48 hours of sanitized prefix traffic (A: Monica)

2) Canary (Week 1–2)
   - Canary window: 10% traffic to dedicated pool for 7 calendar days. Daily QoQ checks (latency, token-cost, hallucination rate)
   - Acceptance criteria: p95 latency < 350ms, token cost within 15% of host baseline, no high-severity hallucination regressions on eval set

3) Staged migration (Week 3)
   - 50% run-rate for 48 hours -> 100% cutover on success
   - Cutover checklist attached (cutover-checklist.xlsx). Rollback plan: revert routing + flush seeded cache; rollback target < 2 hours

4) Training & handoff (Week 4)
   - 3x 90-min remote sessions for product owners (recordings + slide deck)
   - 1x half-day on-site ops training (optional)

Ownership & SLAs:
- Redwood: model provisioning, canary monitoring, rollback execution (Priya / Soojin)
- BlueCanyon: test dataset for model validation, procurement signoff for Dedicated pool (Alex / Jamie)

Open items:
- Procurement timing (procurement@bluecanyon.co) — need PO by EOD 2025-06-24 to meet Week 1 start
- Confirm on-site training date or elect remote-only
- DocuSign: I'll send the MSA addendum for Dedicated capacity (link)

Next steps:
- I'll upload the annotated MAP and a one-page playbook to the shared drive and send a DocuSign link for the addendum today. Can you confirm PO timing and preferred training cadence?

Attachments: BC_MAP_Redwood_comments.pdf, cutover-checklist.xlsx

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--

From: Alex Monroe <alex@bluecanyon.co>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <jamie.park@bluecanyon.co>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation manifest + MAP: BlueCanyon / Redwood

Priya — appreciate the clear plan. A couple of asks from our side:

- Can we move the on-site half-day to Week 2 instead of Week 4? The ops team wants earlier run-throughs before we push 50% traffic. If needed we can make the on-site remote but still sooner.
- Procurement: we are targeting PO submission 2025-06-23 (one business day earlier than your EOD ask). That should be fine but please confirm the impact if PO hits 06/23 instead of 06/24.
- Canary window: would Redwood accept a 5–7 day window where we ramp from 5% -> 15% across the first 3 days (5%, 10%, 15%)? That gives us more gradual exposure.

We also uploaded a sanitized sample of traffic for validation (Drive link below). HubSpot deal: 4532 — I'll add the PO milestone there.

Drive: https://drive.bluecanyon.co/shared/bluecanyon-sanitized-sample.zip
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4532

Thanks — Alex

Alex / Jamie —

All good on our end. Quick confirmations and updated schedule below:

- Canary: we accept the 5% -> 10% -> 15% ramp over first 3 days; total canary period 7 days (metrics check daily).
- On-site training: we can move the half-day to Week 2 (w/c 07/07). We'll also schedule three 90-min remote sessions in Week 0–1 for product owners; calendar invites to follow.

Action owners & dates:
- Priya: upload final MAP + playbook; send DocuSign addendum (by 06/20 17:00)
- Monica: seed KV cache once dedicated pool is provisioned (target 06/27)
- Soojin: run model validation on sanitized sample and report (deliverable 06/26)
- Alex / Jamie: PO submission (target 06/23) and provide final list for on-site attendees (by 06/30)

I'll attach the final annotated MAP to the HubSpot deal and link the DocuSign once signed. If anything changes on PO timing please ping procurement@bluecanyon.co and me immediately.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Best,
